method: Direct view_image inspection of all six PNGs from final run-01.

images.observation: Baseline displays the same six values in a continuous two-column grid; the capture establishes the earlier hierarchy at identical default settings.

Power transfer and motion now form distinct named sections. Input power is prominent and full width; useful and lost power sit together. Task time spans the motion group. Labels, units and model limits remain readable.
Handle rotation forms a separate group after motion, with torque, turns, RPM and angular speed in consistent two-column cards. The rotational equation and budget scope remain visible without overlap.
At 320px the cards stack in reading order. Light labels and values contrast clearly against dark cards; the primary amber edge and group rules keep the hierarchy visible.
At 320px forced colors retain black card boundaries and group rules. All ten screw metrics, the exceeded-budget explanation and the rotational check fit vertically without horizontal clipping.
With reviewed text doubled, headings, labels and the back button wrap naturally. Values remain readable; the entire results region grows vertically without clipping or overlap.

limits: Focused comparison summary, metrics, budget fit and rotary scope review; not a whole-app visual audit.
The 200% text case doubles computed font sizes in the reviewed region, rather than browser zoom.
Screenshots use the real React, THREE, host module and bundled source through the repository native browser harness.
